test_title: PYST 206: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 24th Nov, 2021 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: An amount of Rs. 1,189 is to be divided among Rakesh, Mrinal and Sanjay in the ratio of 11 : 13 : 17, respectively. How much amount will Sanjay get more than Rakesh?
solution:
Total amount = Rs. 1,189

Total amount divided among Rakesh, Mrinal, Sanjay is in ratio of = 11 : 13 : 17

Total amount divided into number of parts = 11 + 13 + 17 = 41 parts

∴ 41 parts = Rs. 1,189

⇒ 1 part = 1189 ÷ 41

⇒ 1 part = Rs. 29

Number of parts Sanjay received = 17 parts

Amount of Sanjay got = 17 × 29 = 493/-

Number of parts Rakesh received = 11 parts

Amount of Rakesh = 11 × 29 = 319

Amount of Sanjay got more than Rakesh = 493 - 319 = 174/-

Hence, the correct answer is **"174".**
